page0.text:
...
...No.
I can't make any careless moves.
I'm worried about Saber. I want to run to her right now and make sure she's okay.

page1.text:
But that would mean turning my back on Zouken.
That would be a fatal mistake.
Defend yourself, Shirou.
That's what Saber told me.
Then, I need to hold out here until the last possible second.

page2.text:
"...Oh? I see, I see. You have a strong bond to her."
...I won't let Zouken's words sway me.
I get a good grip on the kyousaku stick and tense up, ready to respond to any attack.

page3.text:
"Very well, let us have a contest of endurance. You can wait and see whether you made the right choice."
Zouken's murderous intent vanishes.
The old mage takes a step back, melting into the wall of insects.

page4.text:
...
His presence fades.
I stare into the shadows, where he should be.
...
......
.........
............
...............A full minute passes.

page5.text:
"Huh?"
I hear wind howl from afar, and then my left hand throbs with pain.
The back of my hand is tingling.
It hurts where the Command Spells are, almost like I'm bleeding there.

page6.text:
"Saber...?"
I feel awful dread.
I feel awful dread.
I feel awful dread.
The pain in my left hand.
The howling wind, gone silent.
I hear the old mage chuckle from within the mass of hostile bugs.

page7.text: "Looks like it's all taken care of. If you're her Master, you should be able to tell that your Servant is gone from this world!"

page8.text:
...
My mind is paralyzed.
My vision freezes.
What...is he talking about?

page9.text:
"What are you so shocked for? Saber is dead. She underestimated Assassin and lost to him. Is that so hard to grasp, boy?"
"That's..."

page10.text:
...bullshit, right?
My left hand hurts.
It really hurts.
But my Command Spells are still there.
They're growing fainter by the second, like they're about to fade, but they aren't gone yet.
Then Saber still has to be out there, ready to come to me right now!

page11.text:
"TO ME, SABER!"
I scream, trying to drown out the pain.
I cram as much magical energy as I can into my left hand.
I don't know how to use the Command Spells.
But if they're supposed to respond to their Master's wishes, then I'll summon Saber to me right now!

page12.text:
"Argh!"
Nothing happens.
The Command Spells definitely reacted, and then they stopped.

page13.text:
There's nothing wrong with the Command Spells.
Then, that must mean the Servant they called is already...

page14.text:
"Futile. Even the mighty Command Spells cannot resurrect a lost Servant.
Even one as unlucky as you must understand that your Saber has perished at the hands of my Servant."

page15.text:
"Don't you..."
"Let's put an end to this. The Tohsaka girl still has potential, but I have no further use for you. Die in my holy land, along with your Servant!"
"...BULLSHIT ME, MOTHERFUCKER!"

page16.text:
I run.
I charge at the enemy before me, trying to shake off the pain in my left hand and the horrible dread.
